title: staging drain retries pipeline-failed articles forever — no max-retry or dead-letter mechanism
description: main.rs staging drain: on pipeline failure (run_pipeline_and_notify returns false), the staged article is left in transit_staging with no retry counter. It will be re-drained on the next loop iteration. An article that is permanently invalid (e.g. malformed after staging, missing mandatory header not caught by check_ingest) will be retried forever, consuming CPU and IPFS write attempts. The staging schema needs an attempt_count column and a max-attempts policy.
